heading: Extra benefits when you book now
intro: These offers are for a limited time. Visit our office or call us for the full terms.

items.title: Early booking discount
items.text: The first 20 buyers to book get a special discount of up to Tk 1 lakh.

items.title: Cashback offer
items.text: 2% cashback on the total price when you pay in full.

items.title: Interior voucher
items.text: A Tk 25,000 furniture/interior voucher when you sign the contract.

items.title: Monthly raffle draw
items.text: A draw every month among that month's buyers. Prizes: AC, fridge, smart TV.

items.title: Referral gift
items.text: If someone books through your referral, you get a Tk 20,000 gift voucher.
